# Noah Crowley Asbestos and Designated Substances Consulting

> Noah Crowley Consulting is an independent asbestos and designated substances consultancy based in Windsor, Ontario, serving Windsor-Essex, Chatham-Kent, Sarnia-Lambton and London. It surveys buildings, tests materials, keeps O. Reg. 278/05 asbestos records through an annual reassessment, writes abatement specifications, oversees abatement, tests the air and does Type 3 clearance. It never removes asbestos and takes no referral fees.

- Clients: commercial and institutional building owners, landlords and condos, general, restoration and abatement contractors.
- Surveys cover all 11 Ontario designated substances and are priced as a report fee by building size plus samples taken. Prices are CAD before HST.
- Lab results take 10 business days from the lab's receipt. Rush takes 2–3 business days at double the sample price.
- Contact: 519-890-9654, info@crowleyconsulting.ca, https://crowleyconsulting.ca/contact.html

## Services (starting prices, CAD before HST)
- Renovation-scope DSS: from $1,000. Renovation, repair or a tender for one work area. 15 business days.
- Full-building DSS: from $1,500. Acquisition, capital planning, several projects in one building, or no survey on file. 15–20 business days.
- Pre-demolition DSS: from $1,750. A vacant building coming down, or a demolition permit. 20–25 business days.
- Bulk Material Sampling: from $450. A few specific materials before drilling or cutting, or a find mid-job. 10 business days; 2–3 on a call-out.
- Annual Asbestos Reassessment Program: from $1,400. Keeping the O. Reg. 278/05 asbestos record current every year. Yearly.
- Abatement Design & Oversight: from $2,500. Asbestos removal that needs a tender and someone on the owner's side. Specification in 10 business days.
- Clearance Air Testing: from $1,200. A Type 3 enclosure ready to come down. 2–3 business days.
- Asbestos Instruction & Training: from $1,400. Workers in Type 1 and Type 2 operations, or building staff who need awareness training. Half day or full day.
- Peer Review: from $1,200. A second opinion on another firm's survey or abatement specification. 5 or 10 business days.
